mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over 3 consecutive months signals a shift to accommodative monetary policy, lowering discount rates and increasing the present value of future equity cash flows, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 5.25% triggers a sudden tightening cycle, raising discount rates and compressing the present value of future equity cash flows, which produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
